# AVA - AI-native Visual Analytics

> AVA is an AntV TypeScript framework for loading data, answering natural-language questions, and generating visualizations through an SDK, CLI, or Agent Skill.

This documentation covers AVA 4.0. Install `@antv/ava@4` with Node.js 22.13.0 or later. Use `@antv/ava` in Node.js and `@antv/ava/browser` in browsers.

The core workflow is `source()` → `analyze()` → `visualize()`. `source()` replaces the current dataset and returns no value; use `schema()` to inspect it and `profile()` for statistics. Use `suggest()` to discover questions, `translate()` and `query()` to control query execution, or `recommend()` and `viz()` to control chart generation. Always await `dispose()` when finished.

DuckDB is the default Node.js engine. JavaScript supports browsers and Node.js; Python, Supabase, ClickHouse, and BigQuery provide additional Node.js execution options. Follow the linked guides for source support, configuration, and complete API signatures.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/): Core workflow and ways to use AVA.
- [Installation and quickstart](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/quickstart/): Install AVA 4.0, configure a model, and run a complete Node.js example.
- [Agent Skill](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/agent-skill/): Install AVA's agent skill and analyze data with an AI coding agent.
- [Command-line interface](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/reference/cli/): Inspect datasets, run queries, and render charts using persistent local sessions.

## Data, analysis, and visualization

- [Data sources](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/data/sources/): Source types and parameters for inline data, files, and databases.
- [Inspect your data](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/data/schema/): AVA discovers the structural starting point automatically; optionally compute statistics, then supply business meaning through semantic definitions. No schema needs to be authored for ordinary use.
- [Define data semantics](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/data/semantic/): Author business context, model and column mappings, relationships, views, and cubes; includes a worked sales example and links to the complete API fields. Definitions guide query generation and do not materialize objects or enforce access policies.
- [Analyze data](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/analysis/overview/): Ask questions, get suggestions, and translate or execute queries separately.
- [Analysis strategies](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/analysis/strategies/): Choose direct analysis or iterative reasoning.
- [Generate visualizations](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/visualization/overview/): Recommend charts and generate GPT-Vis syntax and HTML.

## Configuration and execution engines

- [Model configuration](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/configuration/): Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider, AI Gateway, or an AI SDK model.
- [Browser usage](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/browser/): Use the browser entry point and JavaScript engine with inline data.
- [Engine overview](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/engines/overview/): Compare execution environments, query languages, and supported sources.
- [DuckDB](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/engines/duckdb/): Run SQL against inline data, files, and attached databases.
- [JavaScript](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/engines/javascript/): Execute JavaScript against an in-memory dataset.
- [Python](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/engines/python/): Analyze with pandas using local Python or an application-provided executor.
- [Supabase and ClickHouse](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/engines/remote/): Discover schemas and execute queries in remote databases.
- [Custom engines](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/engines/custom/): Implement and register a custom analysis engine.

## API reference

- [AVA API](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/reference/api/): Constructor options, method signatures, parameters, defaults, return values, and complete semantic fields and merge rules.
- [Events and lifecycle](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/reference/events/): Observe source loading, model work, query execution, and cleanup.

## Optional

- [Architecture and source map](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/reference/architecture/): Map public capabilities to implementation modules.
- [Benchmarks](https://ava.antv.vision/documentation/reference/benchmarks/): Evaluation results and instructions for reproducing them.
- [AI](https://ava.antv.vision/ai/): Try browser-based visual analytics.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/antvis/AVA): Source code and contribution information.
- [Issues](https://github.com/antvis/AVA/issues): Bug reports and feature requests.

## 中文文档

中文首页：https://ava.antv.vision/zh/ 。英文 URL 保持不变，中文文档使用 /zh/documentation/。

- [认识 AVA](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/): 从一个问题开始，了解 AVA 如何连接数据、执行分析并呈现结果。
- [Agent Skill](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/agent-skill/): 让现有 AI Agent 用上 AVA，完成从数据探索到图表交付的完整流程。
- [安装与快速开始](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/quickstart/): 安装 AVA，接入第一份数据，跑通分析与图表生成。
- [接入数据](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/data/sources/): 连接内存数据、文件、数据库和飞书多维表格。
- [了解你的数据](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/data/schema/): 自动发现表结构，按需查看统计信息，再补充业务背景。
- [补充业务语义](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/data/semantic/): 说明业务口径、字段映射与可复用指标，让分析更贴近实际业务。
- [分析数据](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/analysis/overview/): 用自然语言提问，获得可检查的查询结果与分析结论。
- [选择分析策略](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/analysis/strategies/): 根据问题复杂度，选择直接分析或多步迭代。
- [生成图表](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/visualization/overview/): 把分析结果或已有数据转换成合适的图表。
- [连接模型](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/configuration/): 配置兼容 OpenAI 的服务、AI Gateway 或 AI SDK 模型。
- [在浏览器中使用](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/browser/): 通过浏览器入口使用 JavaScript 引擎，避免引入 Node.js 依赖。
- [选择执行引擎](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/engines/overview/): 决定数据在哪里加载、查询用什么语言、代码在哪里执行。
- [DuckDB](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/engines/duckdb/): 用 SQL 分析内存数据、文件及可连接的数据库。
- [Python](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/engines/python/): 通过本地 Python 或自定义执行器，使用 pandas 分析数据。
- [Supabase 与 ClickHouse](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/engines/remote/): 在远程数据库中发现表结构、执行查询。
- [JavaScript](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/engines/javascript/): 在 Node.js 或浏览器中，对内存数据执行 JavaScript 分析。
- [扩展执行引擎](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/engines/custom/): 实现引擎接口，把自己的数据与执行环境接入 AVA。
- [API 参考](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/reference/api/): 查询构造参数、方法签名、默认值与返回结构。
- [事件与生命周期](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/reference/events/): 观察数据加载、模型调用、查询执行与资源清理。
- [命令行工具](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/reference/cli/): 在终端中加载数据、查询分析、生成图表，并复用本地会话。
- [评测结果](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/reference/benchmarks/): 了解数据上下文与分析策略的评测方法、结果及复现方式。
- [架构与源码导航](https://ava.antv.vision/zh/documentation/reference/architecture/): 从公开 API 出发，找到对应的实现与扩展位置。
